det.analysis: physics(명사) → physical(형용사): 명사 strength를 수식하는 형용사 형태 필요. '신체적 힘'에서 명사 수식 → 형용사
det.tip: physics(명사: 물리학) → physical(형용사: 신체적인/물리적인). 명사 앞 수식은 형용사

questions.passage: In the 1980s, some prisons in the United States painted their cells pink __________ make the prisoners less violent and aggressive. This idea came from the work of a psychologist named Alexander Schauss. Schauss claimed that he had created a special shade of pink that could significantly reduce the strength and aggression of prisoners. He even conducted an experiment that showed a loss of physical strength in participants who had stared at a piece of pink paper. Many people who ran prisons were impressed with Schauss' research, so they agreed to allow him to test the effects of his color on their prisoners. The color is still used today, not only in prisons but also in hospitals and psychiatric institutions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① regardless of(~에 상관없이): 목적이 아닌 양보 표현
✅ ② in order to(~하기 위해): 분홍색을 칠한 '목적'을 나타내는 표현 ← 정답
❌ ③ instead of(~대신에): 대체 표현으로 문맥 부적절
❌ ④ in spite of(~에도 불구하고): 양보 표현으로 문맥 부적절
det.tip: in order to=~하기 위해(=so as to). 목적을 나타내는 to부정사의 강조형

questions.passage: In the 1980s, some prisons in the United States painted their cells pink in order to make the prisoners less violent and aggressive. This idea came from the work of a psychologist named Alexander Schauss. Schauss claimed that he had created a special shade of pink that could significantly reduce the strength and aggression of prisoners. He even conducted an experiment that showed a loss of physical strength in participants who had stared at a piece of pink paper. Many people who ran prisons were impressed with Schauss' research, so they agreed to allow him to test the effects of his color on their prisoners. The color is still used today, __________ and psychiatric institutions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: not only in prisons but also in hospitals 교도소뿐만 아니라 병원에서도
det.analysis:
❌ ① only in prisons and nowhere else: '교도소에서만' → 뒤에 psychiatric institutions 언급되므로 불일치
❌ ② neither in prisons nor in hospitals: '둘 다 아닌' → 여전히 사용된다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ③ not only in prisons but also in hospitals: '교도소뿐만 아니라 병원에서도' 사용 ← 정답
❌ ④ mostly in hospitals rather than prisons: 병원 위주라는 근거 없음
det.tip: not only A but also B = A뿐만 아니라 B도. 상관접속사 구문
